title: feedback wanted. i've not a game dev. what would you improve?
author: BuffaloConscious7919
selftext:
this have become my downtime actually and i've love building this over the last couple of months in the evenings when i'm too tired to work. it brings me a lot of joy to just keep trying things and 'improve it'.

The problem is... i have no idea what i'm doing. it's for fun and i'm having fun but would love some feedback on what works and what doesn't to bring more creativity and quality into the game (or anything else).

for context - I've used Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and Grok models so it's really a bit of a Frankenstein game

comments.author: EnvyUI
comments.body: It's really hard to help you when even you are unsure what you want to achieve. UI looks like standard Opus 5.5 or Claude design. I would suggest you to keep enjoying what you make and keep improving. Take some inspiration from games you like or have similar mechanics.
